en.t: Alfonso I enters Zaragoza after its siege
en.s: On December 18, 1118, King Alfonso I of Aragon entered Zaragoza after a months-long siege of the Almoravid-held city. He visited the Aljafería palace that day and took possession of the government palace on December 19. The city, in present-day Spain, became part of his expanding Aragonese realm.
en.n: Alfonso entered Zaragoza on December 18; taking possession of the government palace followed December 19.

zh.t: 阿方索一世在围城后进入萨拉戈萨
zh.s: 1118年12月18日，阿拉贡国王阿方索一世在围城数月后进入萨拉戈萨。这座城市此前由阿尔摩拉维德王朝控制。他当天参观了阿尔哈费里亚宫，直到12月19日才接管政府宫。位于今天西班牙的萨拉戈萨随后成为阿拉贡领地的一部分。
zh.n: 阿方索一世在12月18日进城，次日才接管政府宫。

en.s: The First Luso–Malabarese War was the first armed conflict fought by the Portuguese Empire in Asia, and the first of nine against the Zamorin of Calicut, then the preeminent power on the Malabar Coast, in India. The conflict erupted in 1500 over trade. Though himself a Hindu, the Zamorin was closely associated with and heavily dependent on the influential Muslim merchant community of Calicut.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 第一次葡萄牙-马拉巴尔战争
zh.s: 第一次葡萄牙-马拉巴尔战争是葡萄牙帝国在亚洲发动的首场武装冲突，也是其与当时马拉巴尔海岸主要势力科泽科德萨莫林王国之间九场冲突中的第一场。冲突于1500年因贸易问题爆发。萨莫林虽是印度教徒，却与科泽科德有影响力的穆斯林商人社群关系密切，并高度依赖他们。

en.s: The Siege of Wolmar occurred during the Polish–Swedish War (1600–1611), between October 18 and December 18, 1601. Polish forces, numbering around 15,000, with 50 pieces of artillery, led by the Grand Crown Hetman Jan Zamoyski besieged the city (present day Valmiera) defended by about 1,000 infantry under Jacob De la Gardie and Carl Carlsson Gyllenhielm. Other notable commanders on the Polish side included the Field Crown Hetman Stanisław Żółkiewski and the field marshal Jürgen von Farensbach (Jerzy Farensbach). The king of Poland, Sigismund III Vasa, was initially present at the siege, but left for Wilno on December 5th.At first the Swedish artillery managed to hold back the Poles who did not intend to storm Wolmar without proper siege cannons.

zh.s: 沃尔马尔围城战发生于1600—1611年的波兰—瑞典战争期间，时间为1601年10月18日至12月18日。扬·扎莫厄斯基率领约1.5万名波兰军队和50门火炮围攻这座城市（今拉脱维亚瓦尔米耶拉），守军约有1000名步兵，由雅各布·德·拉加迪和卡尔·卡尔松·耶伦希尔姆指挥。波兰方面的其他重要指挥官包括王冠大元帅斯坦尼斯瓦夫·若乌凯夫斯基和元帅尤尔根·冯·法伦斯巴赫（耶日·法伦斯巴赫）。波兰国王齐格蒙特三世·瓦萨起初也在围城现场，但于12月5日前往维尔纽斯。起初，瑞典炮兵挡住了波兰军队；波兰人不打算在没有合适攻城炮的情况下强攻沃尔马尔。

en.s: The Battle of Mbumbi was a military engagement between forces of Portuguese Angola and the Kingdom of Kongo in 1622. Although the Portuguese were victorious, the battle served as the impetus for the Kingdom of Kongo to expel the Portuguese from their territory.

zh.s: 1622年，葡属安哥拉军队与刚果王国军队在姆班比交战。葡萄牙军队虽然获胜，但这场战斗促使刚果王国将葡萄牙人逐出其领土。

en.t: The Whitehall Conference ends with the determination that there was no law preventing Jews from re-entering England after the Edict of Expulsion of 1290
en.s: The Whitehall Conference was a gathering of prominent English merchants, clergymen, and lawyers convened by Oliver Cromwell for the purpose of debating whether Jews should be readmitted to England. The conference lasted from 4 to 18 December 1655. While Cromwell himself was in favour of Jewish resettlement, the participants ultimately broke down into three groups.

zh.t: 白厅会议结束，与会者认定1290年驱逐令之后并无法律禁止犹太人重返英格兰
zh.s: 白厅会议由奥利弗·克伦威尔召集，参加者包括英国商人、教士和律师，议题是是否应允许犹太人重返英格兰。会议于1655年12月4日至18日举行。克伦威尔本人支持犹太人回迁，但与会者最终分成了三派。

en.s: The Battle of Galudoghson took place in December 1742, at a site near present-day Glasgow, Virginia, when the Augusta County militia engaged in combat with Onondaga and Oneida Indians. These warriors had traveled to Virginia from Pennsylvania under the command of a Haudenosaunee chief named Jonnhaty, to participate in a campaign against the Catawba. The battle was the first armed conflict between settlers in Western Virginia and Native Americans.

zh.s: 1742年12月18日，奥古斯塔县民兵在今弗吉尼亚州格拉斯哥附近与奥农达加人和奥奈达人交战。这些战士由豪德诺索尼联盟首领乔恩纳蒂率领，从宾夕法尼亚前往弗吉尼亚，参加针对卡托巴人的军事行动。这场战斗是西弗吉尼亚殖民者与美洲原住民之间的首次武装冲突。

en.s: In this article, dates are given in the Julian calendar in use in England at the time, unless otherwise stated. The Clifton Moor Skirmish took place between forces of the United Kingdom Hanoverian government and Jacobite rebels on Wednesday 18 December 1745 (29 December Gregorian). Since the commander of the government forces, the Duke of Cumberland, was aware of the Jacobite presence in Derby, the Jacobite leader Prince Charles Edward Stuart decided to retreat north back towards Scotland. Charles began his retreat from Derby on 6 December 1745.

zh.s: 本文日期采用当时英格兰使用的儒略历，另有说明的除外。1745年12月18日（公历12月29日，星期三），英国汉诺威政府军与詹姆斯党叛军在克利夫顿沼地交战。政府军指挥官坎伯兰公爵得知詹姆斯党军队在德比后，詹姆斯党领袖查尔斯·爱德华·斯图亚特王子决定向北撤回苏格兰。查尔斯于1745年12月6日开始从德比撤退。

en.s: The Battle of Martinique was a naval encounter on 18 December 1779 between a British 13-ship squadron under Admiral Hyde Parker and a three-ship French division under Admiral Lamotte-Picquet near the island of Martinique in the West Indies. In order to cover the retreat of a convoy under Joseph de Flotte chased by the British, the lone 74-gun Annibal, under Lamotte-Picquet.

zh.s: 1779年12月18日，海军上将海德·帕克率领的英国13艘舰艇分舰队在西印度群岛马提尼克岛附近，与拉莫特-皮凯率领的法国3艘舰艇分队交战。英国舰队追击约瑟夫·德·弗洛特率领的船队，拉莫特-皮凯为掩护船队撤退，率领74炮舰“阿尼巴尔”号独自迎战；该舰独自阻挡英军推进约90分钟。

en.t: New Jersey becomes the third state to ratify the U.S. Constitution
en.s: New Jersey is a state located in both the Mid-Atlantic and Northeastern regions of the United States. Located at the geographic hub of the heavily urbanized Northeast megalopolis, it is bordered to the northwest, north, and northeast by New York State; on its east, southeast, and south by the Atlantic Ocean; on its west by the Delaware River and Pennsylvania; and on its southwest by Delaware Bay and Delaware.

zh.t: 新泽西州成为第三个批准美国宪法的州
zh.s: 新泽西州位于美国中大西洋地区和东北地区，地处东北部城市群的中心。该州西北、北部和东北部与纽约州接壤，东、东南和南部濒临大西洋，西部与宾夕法尼亚州隔特拉华河相望，西南部濒临特拉华湾。

en.s: The Battle of Villelongue (7 and 18 December 1793) saw a Royal Spanish force from the army commanded by Antonio Ricardos attack a position held by a Republican French force from the army led by François Amédée Doppet. Spanish and French attack columns passed each other in the night without detecting each other. On 7 December, the Spanish attack on Villelongue-dels-Monts was delivered first and was completely successful, causing the French soldiers to flee.

zh.s: 维勒隆格战役发生于1793年12月7日和18日。安东尼奥·里卡多斯指挥的西班牙军队进攻弗朗索瓦·阿梅代·多佩指挥的法兰西共和军阵地。西法两军的进攻纵队夜间交错而过，彼此都没有发现对方。12月7日，西班牙军队首先进攻维勒隆格德尔蒙，行动完全成功，法军士兵被迫逃离。

en.s: The Federalist revolts were uprisings that broke out in various parts of France in the summer of 1793, during the French Revolution. They were prompted by resentments in France's provincial cities about increasing centralisation of power in Paris, and increasing radicalisation of political authority in the hands of the Jacobins. In most of the country, the trigger for uprising was the exclusion of the Girondins from the National Convention after the Insurrection of 31 May – 2 June 1793.

zh.s: 法国大革命期间，1793年夏天法国多个地区爆发联邦派叛乱。地方城市居民不满巴黎权力日益集中、雅各宾派政治路线不断激进化，因而起事。在大多数地区，起义的直接导火索是吉伦特派在1793年5月31日至6月2日的起义后被排除出国民公会。

en.s: The 1798 South Carolina gubernatorial election was held on December 18, 1798, in order to elect the Governor of South Carolina. Federalist candidate and former member of the South Carolina Senate Edward Rutledge was elected by the South Carolina General Assembly against fellow Federalist candidate and former Governor William Moultrie.

zh.s: 南卡罗来纳州于1798年12月18日举行州长选举。联邦党候选人、南卡罗来纳州前参议员爱德华·拉特利奇当选，击败了同为联邦党人的前州长威廉·莫尔特里。选举由南卡罗来纳州议会投票决定。

en.s: The siege of Riga was a military operation during the Napoleonic Wars. The siege lasted five months from July – December 1812, during which the left flank of Napoleon's "Great Army" (La Grande Armée) tried to gain a favorable position for an attack on Russian-controlled port city Riga, the capital of the Governorate of Livonia. They failed to cross the Daugava River, and accordingly the siege was not carried out completely.

en.s: The Battle of Mudki was fought on 18 December 1845, between the forces of the British East India Company and a part of the Sikh Khalsa Army, the army of the Sikh Empire. The British army were able to win the battle, despite suffering heavy casualties in the process.

zh.s: 穆德基战役于1845年12月18日打响，交战双方是英国东印度公司军队和锡克帝国的部分卡尔萨军。英国军队虽然损失惨重，最终仍赢得了战斗。

en.s: The Battle of Lexington in Tennessee was a small battle of the American Civil War, fought at Lexington, Tennessee on December 18, 1862, as part of General Nathan Bedford Forrest's cavalry raid into western Tennessee. In late 1862, the main Union army in the west was in northern Mississippi. General Braxton Bragg sent General Forrest to raid into Tennessee against the Mobile and Ohio Railroad, which was a Union supply line.

zh.t: 田纳西州列克星敦战役
zh.s: 田纳西州列克星敦战役是美国内战中的一场小规模战斗，于1862年12月18日在田纳西州列克星敦打响，属于内森·贝德福德·福雷斯特骑兵突袭田纳西州西部行动的一部分。1862年末，西部联邦军主力驻扎在密西西比州北部。布拉克斯顿·布拉格将军派福雷斯特袭击田纳西州的莫比尔—俄亥俄铁路，这条铁路是联邦军的补给线。

en.t: A magnitude 7.0 earthquakes strikes off the coast of Taiwan, triggering a tsunami and killing at least 580 people
en.s: The 1867 Keelung earthquake occurred off the northern coast of Taiwan on the morning of December 18 with a magnitude of 7.0. It produced strong shaking that seriously damaged the cities of Keelung and Taipei. A tsunami drowned hundreds and had a run-up exceeding 15 m (49 ft), possibly the only confirmed widely destructive and deadly tsunami in Taiwan's history.

zh.t: 1867年台湾北部海域7.0级地震引发海啸，至少造成580人死亡
zh.s: 1867年基隆地震于12月18日上午发生在台湾北部海域，震级为7.0。强烈震动严重损坏基隆和台北两座城市。海啸淹死数百人，爬高超过15米（49英尺），可能是台湾历史上唯一一次经确认造成大范围破坏和人员死亡的海啸。

en.s: The Battle of Pesmes was part of the Franco-Prussian War. It took place from December 16 to 18, 1870, at the French commune of Pesmes, on the river Ognon between Gray and Dole. The Prussian army, which included Uhlans (light cavalry) and artillery, defeated the French army and achieved their goal of destroying the bridge over the Ognon river. Simultaneously, the Prussian army under the command of General August von Werder captured Nuits-Saint-Georges from the hands of French commander, Camille Crémer on 18 December 1870.

zh.s: 佩斯梅战役是普法战争的一部分，于1870年12月16日至18日在法国佩斯梅镇、格雷与多勒之间的奥尼翁河畔进行。普鲁士军队包括乌兰轻骑兵和炮兵，击败法军并实现了炸毁奥尼翁河桥梁的目标。同一时期，奥古斯特·冯·韦尔德将军指挥的普军于1870年12月18日从法国指挥官卡米耶·克雷梅手中夺取努瓦圣乔治。

en.s: The Battle of Nuits-Saint-Georges was a battle in the Franco-Prussian War, which took place on December 18, 1870. In this battle, the Baden Division of Germany commanded by General Adolf von Glümer and the XIV Legion under the command of General August von Werder, took Nuits from a French force led by General Camille Crémer, forced the French army to withdraw overnight with heavy losses for both sides.

zh.s: 努瓦圣乔治战役是普法战争中的一场战斗，于1870年12月18日打响。德国巴登师由阿道夫·冯·格吕默将军指挥，另有奥古斯特·冯·韦尔德将军指挥的第十四军团参战。他们从卡米耶·克雷梅将军率领的法军手中夺取努瓦圣乔治，迫使法军连夜撤退，双方均损失惨重。

en.t: 1877 United States Senate election in California
en.s: The 1877 United States Senate election in California was held on December 18, 1877, by the California State Legislature to elect a U.S. senator (Class 3) to represent the State of California in the United States Senate. Democratic state senator James T. Farley was elected over Republican State Assemblyman Morris M. Estee.

en.s: The First Battle of Vailele occurred on 18 December 1888 at the German plantation of Vailele, Samoa. Sixteen German marines were ambushed and killed by forces loyal to Mata'afa Iosefo. A memorial for the Germans killed at the battle was erected in a ceremony presided over by the commander of the unprotected cruiser Sperber.

en.s: The Battle of Halai, or the Battle of Halay, which took place in December 1894 was a battle between an Eritrean rebel force under Bahta Hagos and the Italian army. en.s: The 1899 Sanitary Board Election was supposed to be held on 18 December 1899 for the 2 unofficial seats in the Sanitary Board of Hong Kong. Only persons on the jury lists of the year were eligible to vote. There were only two candidates therefore only 19 votes were cast as a formality. Prior to the election, the issue of reconstitution of the Sanitary Board was intensively debated. A plebiscite of the British community based on the jury lists was held in June 1896, as to whether Sanitary Board should contain an official or unofficial majority.

en.s: The Moscow uprising, centered in Moscow's Presnensky district between 7 and 18 December 1905, was the climax of the Russian Revolution of 1905. Thousands of workers joined an armed rebellion against the imperial government fighting for better societal conditions. The uprising ended in defeat for the revolutionaries and provoked a swift counter-revolution that lasted until 1907.

zh.s: 1905年12月7日至18日，起义在莫斯科普列斯尼亚区达到高潮，成为1905年俄国革命的顶点。数千名工人加入武装起义，反抗帝国政府，争取改善社会状况。起义以革命者失败告终，并引发迅速展开的反革命运动，持续至1907年。

en.s: The Ovambo Uprising was an uprising against Portuguese colonial rule during World War I. It lasted from 18 December 1914 to 6 February 1917 with the death of its leader, King Mandume yaNdemufayo, by South African forces in Namibia. The war pitted Portuguese troops, commanded by General António Júlio da Costa Pereira de Eça, against an Ovambo army, composed mainly of fighters from the Oukwanyama clan.

zh.s: 第一次世界大战期间，奥万博人发动起义，反抗葡萄牙殖民统治。起义于1914年12月18日爆发，持续至1917年2月6日；南非军队在纳米比亚杀死了起义领袖曼杜梅·亚恩德穆法约国王。交战双方是安东尼奥·朱利奥·达科斯塔·佩雷拉·德埃萨将军指挥的葡萄牙军队和奥万博军队，后者主要由奥克万亚马部族的战士组成。

en.s: Naulila was the scene of fighting between Portuguese Angola and German South West Africa during the early stages of World War I. On 19 October 1914, a German military column crossed the border and entered Angola without authorization from the Portuguese authorities in the Naulila Incident. The column was intercepted by Portuguese forces and conducted to Fort Naulila.

zh.s: 第一次世界大战初期，葡属安哥拉的瑙利拉发生了葡萄牙与德属西南非洲之间的战斗。1914年10月19日，一支德国军队纵队未经葡萄牙当局许可越境进入安哥拉，引发“瑙利拉事件”。葡萄牙军队拦截该纵队，并将其押送至瑙利拉堡。

en.s: The Battle of Verdun (French: Bataille de Verdun [bataj də vɛʁdœ̃]; German: Schlacht um Verdun [ʃlaxt ʔʊm ˈvɛɐ̯dœ̃]) was fought from 21 February to 18 December 1916 on the Western Front in France. The battle was the longest of the First World War and took place on the hills north of Verdun.
en.n: World War I: The Battle of Verdun ends when the second French offensive pushes the Germans back two or three kilometres, causing them to cease their attacks.

zh.s: 凡尔登战役于1916年2月21日至12月18日在法国西线进行。这是第一次世界大战中持续时间最长的战役，战场位于凡尔登以北的丘陵地带。
zh.n: 第一次世界大战：法国第二次攻势将德军击退两三公里，德军因此停止进攻，凡尔登战役结束。

en.t: Eighteenth Amendment to the United States Constitution
en.s: The Eighteenth Amendment (Amendment XVIII) to the United States Constitution established the prohibition of alcohol in the United States. The amendment was proposed by Congress on December 18, 1917, and ratified by the requisite number of states on January 16, 1919. The Eighteenth Amendment was repealed by the Twenty-first Amendment on December 5, 1933, making it the only constitutional amendment in American history to be repealed. The Eighteenth Amendment was the product of decades of efforts by the temperance movement, which held that a ban on the sale of alcohol would ameliorate poverty and other societal problems.

zh.t: 美国宪法第十八修正案
zh.s: 美国宪法第十八修正案（修正案 XVIII）确立了美国禁酒制度。国会于1917年12月18日提出该修正案，1919年1月16日获得足够州批准。1933年12月5日通过第二十一修正案废除了第十八修正案，这是美国历史上唯一一项被废除的宪法修正案。该修正案源自禁酒运动数十年的努力；运动支持者认为，禁止销售酒类可以减轻贫困和其他社会问题。

en.s: The Boston mayoral election of 1917 occurred on Tuesday, December 18, 1917. Andrew James Peters, Assistant Secretary of the Treasury, defeated incumbent Mayor of Boston James Michael Curley and two other candidates. Peters was inaugurated on Monday, February 4, 1918.

zh.s: 1917年波士顿市长选举于1917年12月18日（星期二）举行。时任财政部助理部长安德鲁·詹姆斯·彼得斯击败了波士顿现任市长詹姆斯·迈克尔·柯利和另外两名候选人。彼得斯于1918年2月4日（星期一）宣誓就职。

en.t: French troops land in Odessa during the Russian Civil War
en.s: On December 18, 1918, French troops landed in Odessa as part of the Allied intervention in the Russian Civil War. The landing took place on the Black Sea coast in what is now Ukraine. It began a French-led intervention in the region that continued into 1919.
en.n: This records the French landing at Odessa, rather than every later operation in the wider intervention.

zh.t: 法军在俄国内战期间登陆敖德萨
zh.s: 1918年12月18日，法军在敖德萨登陆，这是协约国干涉俄国内战的一部分。登陆地位于黑海沿岸、今天的乌克兰境内。此后，法国主导的干涉行动在当地持续到1919年。
zh.n: 此条记录法军在敖德萨的登陆，并非整个干涉行动中后来发生的所有战事。

en.s: A by-election was held for the Australian House of Representatives seat of Kalgoorlie on 18 December 1920. It was triggered by the expulsion from the House of Labor Party MP Hugh Mahon. The subsequent by-election was won by Nationalist Party candidate George Foley. It is the only federal by-election in Australian history at which the government has won a seat from the opposition.

zh.s: 1920年12月18日，澳大利亚众议院卡尔古利选区举行补选。工党议员休·马洪被逐出众议院，引发了这场补选。民族党候选人乔治·福利随后胜出。这是澳大利亚联邦补选史上唯一一次执政党从反对党手中赢得席位。

en.s: The 1921 football game between Hungary and Poland was a friendly match played on 18 December 1921, of historical importance in Poland, as it was the first international match in the history of the Poland national football team. Even though Hungary won the match 1–0, the game helped Poland establish its national football team following its reestablishment as a sovereign nation following World War I.

zh.s: 匈牙利与波兰于1921年12月18日进行了一场友谊赛。这场比赛在波兰足球史上意义重大，因为它是波兰国家足球队历史上的首场国际比赛。匈牙利以1比0获胜，但这场比赛也推动波兰在第一次世界大战后恢复主权、重建国家队。

en.s: The Battle of Guangzhou was an internal conflict within the National Revolutionary Army in the aftermath of Chiang Kai-shek's successes in the Northern Expedition. It occurred shortly after the Chinese Communist Party-led Guangzhou Uprising, which was crushed by Li Jishen's opponent Zhang Fakui in December 1927. On December 29, 1927, Li Jishen's forces were able to capture Guangzhou, and Miao Peinan retreated to Huizhou.

zh.s: 广州战役是国民革命军内部的一场冲突，发生在蒋介石北伐取得进展后不久。它紧随1927年12月中国共产党领导的广州起义之后；起义遭李济深的对手张发奎击败。12月29日，李济深部队攻占广州，苗沛霖撤往惠州。

en.s: The Hutt by-election was a by-election in the New Zealand electorate of Hutt, an urban seat at the bottom of the North Island. The by-election was held on 18 December 1929, and was precipitated by the resignation of sitting United MP Thomas Wilford on who had been appointed the High Commissioner to the United Kingdom by Prime Minister Joseph Ward. The by-election was contested by Walter Nash of the Labour Party, James Kerr from the United Party and Harold Johnston of the Reform Party. The lead up to the by-election was marred by harsh words between candidates.

zh.s: 1929年新西兰赫特选区举行补选。时任联合党议员托马斯·威尔福德辞职，原因是总理约瑟夫·沃德任命他为驻英国高级专员。补选于1929年12月18日举行，候选人包括工党候选人沃尔特·纳什、联合党候选人詹姆斯·克尔和改革党候选人哈罗德·约翰斯顿。竞选期间，候选人之间言辞激烈。

en.t: The Chicago Bears defeat the Portsmouth Spartans in the first NFL playoff game to win the NFL Championship
en.s: The 1932 NFL Playoff Game was an extra game held to break a tie in the 1932 season's final standings in the National Football League (NFL); it matched the host Chicago Bears and the Portsmouth Spartans. Because of snowfall and anticipated extremely cold temperatures in Chicago, Illinois, it was moved indoors and played at the three-year-old Chicago Stadium on December 18 on a reduced-size field on Sunday night.

zh.t: 芝加哥熊队击败朴茨茅斯斯巴达人队，赢得首场NFL季后赛及NFL冠军
zh.s: 1932年NFL季后赛是一场加赛，用于打破该赛季NFL常规赛最终排名的平局。比赛由主场作战的芝加哥熊队对阵朴茨茅斯斯巴达人队。由于芝加哥降雪，且预报气温将极低，比赛改在室内举行，于12月18日（星期日）晚在芝加哥体育场进行，球场尺寸也有所缩小。该场馆建成仅三年。

en.s: The 1935 Czechoslovak presidential election took place on 18 December 1935. Edvard Beneš was elected the second President of Czechoslovakia and replaced Tomáš Garrigue Masaryk. Beneš's victory was considered unlikely due to lack of support in a parliament but negotiations helped him to win much larger support than Masaryk has ever received.

zh.s: 捷克斯洛伐克于1935年12月18日举行总统选举。爱德华·贝奈斯当选第二任总统，接替托马什·加里格·马萨里克。贝奈斯起初在议会缺少支持，胜选并不被看好，但经过协商，他获得了比马萨里克历次选举都多得多的支持。

en.t: The Lanka Sama Samaja Party is founded in Ceylon
en.s: The Lanka Sama Samaja Party, often abbreviated as LSSP (lit. 'Lanka Equal Society Party', Sinhala: ලංකා සම සමාජ පක්ෂය, Tamil: லங்கா சமசமாஜக் கட்சி), is a major Trotskyist political party in Sri Lanka. It was the first political party in Sri Lanka (at the time known as British Ceylon), having been founded in 1935 by Leslie Goonewardene, N. M. Perera, Colvin R. de Silva, Philip Gunawardena and Robert Gunawardena.

zh.t: 兰卡平等社会党在锡兰成立
zh.s: 兰卡平等社会党（简称LSSP；僧伽罗语：ලංකා සම සමාජ පක්ෂය；泰米尔语：லங்கா சமசமாஜக் கட்சி）是斯里兰卡主要的托洛茨基主义政党。该党成立于1935年，由莱斯利·古纳瓦德纳、N. M. 佩雷拉、科尔文·R. 德席尔瓦、菲利普·古纳瓦德纳和罗伯特·古纳瓦德纳创立，是斯里兰卡（当时称英属锡兰）的第一个政党。

en.t: World War II: The Battle of the Heligoland Bight, the first major air battle of the war, takes place
en.s: The Battle of the Heligoland Bight was the first "named" air battle of the Second World War, which began the longest air campaign of the war on 3 September 1939, the Defence of the Reich. After the declaration of war, RAF Bomber Command began operations against Nazi Germany but limited their attacks to those targets that were purely military and had little risk of civilian casualties.

zh.t: 第二次世界大战：赫尔戈兰湾海战爆发，这是战争期间第一场主要空战
zh.s: 赫尔戈兰湾海战是第二次世界大战中第一场以专名记载的空战，也拉开了战争中持续时间最长的空战战役“帝国防卫战”的序幕。1939年9月3日宣战后，英国皇家空军轰炸机司令部开始对纳粹德国展开行动，但最初只攻击军事目标，以尽量避免平民伤亡。

en.s: The Lorraine campaign was the operations of the U.S. Third Army in Lorraine during World War II from September 1 through December 18, 1944. Official U.S. Army campaign names for this period and location are Northern France and Rhineland. The term was popularized by the publication of the volume The Lorraine Campaign of the official history of the U.S. Army in 1950.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间，美国第三军团于1944年9月1日至12月18日在洛林地区展开作战。美国陆军对这一时期和地区的官方战役名称是“法国北部”和“莱茵兰”。1950年，美国陆军官方战史出版了《洛林战役》一书，此后这一名称广为使用。

en.s: Operation Ichi-Go (Japanese: 一号作戦, romanized: Ichi-gō Sakusen, lit. 'Operation Number One') was a campaign with several battles between the Imperial Japanese Army forces and the National Revolutionary Army of the Republic of China, fought from April to December 1944. It consisted of three battles in the Chinese provinces of Henan, Hunan and Guangxi.
en.n: World War II: XX Bomber Command responds to the Japanese Operation Ichi-Go offensive by dropping five hundred tons of incendiary bombs on a supply base in Hankow, China.

zh.s: 一号作战（日语：一号作戦，罗马字：Ichi-gō Sakusen，意为“第一号作战”）是日本帝国陆军与中华民国国民革命军在1944年4月至12月间进行的一系列战役，涉及河南、湖南和广西三省。
zh.n: 第二次世界大战：美国第二十轰炸机司令部向中国汉口一处补给基地投下500吨燃烧弹，以回应日军一号作战攻势。

en.s: The Battle of Clervaux or the Battle for Clervaux (in English sources, Clervaux is occasionally called by the German name Clerf) was an opening engagement of the Battle of the Bulge that took place in the town of Clervaux in northern Luxembourg. It lasted from December 16 to 18, 1944. German forces encircled numerically inferior American forces, primarily from the 28th Infantry Division's 110th Infantry Regiment and the 109th Field Artillery Battalion, and quickly forced them to surrender.

zh.s: 克莱沃战役（英语资料有时将克莱沃称为德语名“克莱尔夫”）是突出部战役初期的一场战斗，发生在卢森堡北部的克莱沃镇，时间为1944年12月16日至18日。德军包围了人数较少的美军，主要包括第28步兵师第110步兵团和第109野战炮兵营，并很快迫使他们投降。

en.t: The Supreme Court of the United States issued its decision in Korematsu v. United States supporting Franklin D. Roosevelt's Executive Order 9066 which cleared the way for the incarceration of nearly all 120,000 Japanese Americans, two-thirds of whom were U.S. citizens, born and raised in the United States
en.s: The Supreme Court of the United States (SCOTUS) is the highest court in the federal judiciary of the United States. It has ultimate appellate jurisdiction over all U.S. federal court cases, and over state court cases that turn on questions of U.S. constitutional or federal law. It also has original jurisdiction over a narrow range of cases, specifically "all Cases affecting Ambassadors, other public Ministers and Consuls, and those in which a State shall be Party".

zh.t: 美国最高法院就“科雷松诉合众国案”作出裁决，支持罗斯福第9066号行政命令，为拘禁近12万名日裔美国人铺平道路
zh.s: 美国最高法院是美国联邦司法体系的最高法院，对所有联邦案件以及涉及美国宪法或联邦法律问题的州法院案件拥有最终上诉管辖权。它还对有限类别的案件拥有初审管辖权，具体包括涉及大使、其他外交使节和领事的案件，以及州作为当事方的案件。

en.s: The 1949 Cupa României final was the 12th final of Romania's most prestigious football cup competition. It was disputed between CSCA București and CSU Cluj, and was won by CSCA after a game with 3 goals. It was the first cup title in the history of CSCA București.

zh.s: 1949年罗马尼亚杯决赛是该项赛事第12届决赛，由布加勒斯特中央体育协会队（CSCA București）对阵克卢日大学队（CSU Cluj）。双方共打进3球，CSCA取胜，首次赢得罗马尼亚杯。

en.s: The 1955 Cupa României final was the 18th final of Romania's most prestigious football cup competition. It was disputed between CCA București and Progresul Oradea, and was won by CCA București after a game with nine goals, in extra time. It was the fifth cup for CCA București. Progresul Oradea was the forth club representing Divizia B which reached the Romanian Cup final, after CAM Timișoara in 1938, Flacăra Mediaș in 1951 and Metalul Reșița in 1954.

zh.s: 1955年罗马尼亚杯决赛是罗马尼亚最重要足球杯赛的第18届决赛，由布加勒斯特CCA队对阵奥拉迪亚进步队。双方在比赛中共打进9球，CCA队在加时赛后获胜，这是该队第五次夺冠。奥拉迪亚进步队是第四支闯入罗马尼亚杯决赛的乙级球队；此前曾有1938年的蒂米什瓦拉CAM队、1951年的梅迪亚什火焰队和1954年的雷希察金属队。

en.s: On December 18–20, 1957, a significant tornado outbreak sequence affected the southern Midwest and the South of the contiguous United States. The outbreak sequence began on the afternoon of December 18, when a low-pressure area approached the southern portions of Missouri and Illinois. Supercells developed and proceeded eastward at horizontal speeds of 40 to 45 miles per hour (64 to 72 km/h), yielding what was considered the most severe tornado outbreak in Illinois on record so late in the calendar year.

zh.t: 1957年12月18日至20日龙卷风暴发过程
zh.s: 1957年12月18日至20日，美国中西部南部和南部地区遭遇严重龙卷风。风暴过程于12月18日下午开始，当时一个低压区逼近密苏里州和伊利诺伊州南部。超级单体雷暴形成后向东移动，速度为每小时40至45英里（64至72公里），引发伊利诺伊州有记录以来在如此晚的年份中最严重的一次龙卷风过程。

en.t: The United States launched SCORE (rocket pictured), the world's first communications satellite
en.s: SCORE (Signal Communications by Orbiting Relay Equipment) was the world's first purpose-built communications satellite. Launched on December 18,1958, SCORE provided the first broadcast of a human voice from space. It was also the first successful usage of the Atlas rocket as a launch vehicle, The satellite was popularly dubbed "The Talking Atlas" as well as "Chatterbox".

zh.t: 美国发射SCORE，世界上第一颗通信卫星
zh.s: SCORE（轨道中继设备信号通信系统）是世界上第一颗专门设计的通信卫星，于1958年12月18日发射。它首次从太空播送人声，也是阿特拉斯火箭首次成功用于卫星发射。这颗卫星被大众称为“会说话的阿特拉斯”或“话匣子”。

en.s: Operation Game Warden was a joint operation conducted by the United States Navy and South Vietnamese Navy in order to deny Viet Cong access to resources in the Mekong River Delta. en.t: Saturn's moon Epimetheus is discovered by astronomer Richard Walker
en.s: Epimetheus is an inner satellite of Saturn. It is named after the titan Epimetheus, the brother of Prometheus and son of Iapetus.

zh.s: 土卫十一是土星的一颗内侧卫星，名称取自泰坦神族的厄庇米修斯；厄庇米修斯是普罗米修斯的兄弟，也是伊阿珀托斯之子。

en.s: Operation Muscatine was a security operation conducted during the Vietnam War by the US Army in Quảng Ngãi Province, South Vietnam from 18 December 1967 to 10 June 1968. During this operation on 16 March 1968 the 1st Battalion, 20th Infantry Regiment and the 4th Battalion, 3rd Infantry Regiment carried out the My Lai Massacre.

zh.s: 马斯卡廷行动是越南战争期间美国陆军在南越广义省开展的一项安全行动，时间为1967年12月18日至1968年6月10日。1968年3月16日，行动中的第20步兵团第1营和第3步兵团第4营实施了美莱村屠杀。

en.s: Operation Linebacker II, sometimes referred to as the Christmas bombings and, in Vietnam, the Twelve days and nights, or Điện Biên Phủ of the Sky, was a strategic bombing campaign conducted by the United States against military and industrial areas of North Vietnam from 18 December to 29 December 1972, during the Vietnam War. en.t: Soviet Soyuz 13 spacecraft launches with two cosmonauts
en.s: On December 18, 1973, the Soviet Union launched Soyuz 13 from the Baykonur Cosmodrome, in what is now Kazakhstan. Cosmonauts Pyotr Klimuk and Valentin Lebedev began an eight-day mission focused on scientific experiments. Their flight overlapped with the U.S. Skylab 4 crew’s time in orbit, the first time American and Soviet crews were in space at the same time.
en.n: Launch day; Kazakhstan is the modern country of the launch site, which was then part of the Soviet Union.

zh.t: 苏联发射载有两名宇航员的“联盟13号”飞船
zh.s: 1973年12月18日，苏联从拜科努尔航天发射场发射“联盟13号”飞船。发射场位于今天的哈萨克斯坦。宇航员彼得·克利穆克和瓦连京·列别杰夫开始了为期八天、以科学实验为主的任务。当时美国“天空实验室4号”乘组也在轨道上，这是美苏宇航员首次同时进入太空。
zh.n: 记录发射日期；当时的拜科努尔属苏联，现位于哈萨克斯坦。

en.s: An indirect election for the position of President of the Hellenic Republic was held by the Hellenic Parliament on 18 December 1974. Following the restoration of democracy in Greece, the 17 November 1974 election, and the abolition of the Greek monarchy in the 8 December 1974 referendum, distinguished jurist and former president of the Council of State Michail Stasinopoulos was elected as the first, provisional, President of the Third Hellenic Republic on 18 December with 206 votes. He served as an interim president until July 1975, when Konstantinos Tsatsos replaced him as the first regular President with the full five-year term.

zh.s: 希腊议会于1974年12月18日举行间接选举，选出希腊共和国总统。希腊恢复民主、1974年11月17日举行大选、并在12月8日公投废除君主制后，著名法学家、前国务委员会主席米哈伊尔·斯塔西诺普洛斯以206票当选第三希腊共和国首任临时总统。他任临时总统至1975年7月，之后由康斯坦丁诺斯·察措斯接任，成为首位任满五年完整任期的正式总统。

en.s: United Airlines Flight 2860 was a scheduled domestic cargo flight in the United States from San Francisco, California, to Chicago, Illinois, with an intermediate stop added at Salt Lake City, Utah. en.s: The Tupolev Tu-160 (Russian: Туполев Ту-160 «Белый лебедь», romanized: Bely Lebed, lit. zh.s: 图波列夫图-160（俄语：Туполев Ту-160“白天鹅”；北约代号：海盗旗）是苏联/俄罗斯的一种可携带核武器的超音速可变后掠翼重型战略轰炸机和空射导弹平台，由图波列夫设计局于20世纪70年代设计。该机机身长54米，比波音B-52“同温层堡垒”更长；机翼展开时翼展为56米，后掠时为36米。

en.s: The Trans Service Airlift Lockheed L-188 crash occurred on 18 December 1995 when a Lockheed L-188C Electra owned by Trans Service Airlift crashed near Jamba, Angola, killing 141 of the passengers and crew. Trans Service Airlift (TSA), was a private company headquartered at Ndjili Airport, Kinshasa. The Electra was one of a number of ageing aircraft operated by TSA. Built in 1959 it was sold to TSA in 1992, after service with other operators. On the date of the accident, the aircraft was flying a special charter for UNITA. Following the 1993 trade embargo on UNITA there were frequent "sanction busting" flights out of Zaire.

zh.s: 1995年12月18日，Trans Service Airlift公司的一架洛克希德L-188C Electra客机在安哥拉贾姆巴附近坠毁，机上141名乘客和机组人员遇难。这家简称TSA的私营公司总部设在金沙萨恩吉利机场。Electra是TSA运营的多架老旧飞机之一。这架飞机于1959年制造，1992年在曾由其他运营商使用后售予TSA。事故当天，飞机执行的是一趟为争取安哥拉彻底独立全国联盟（UNITA）安排的包机。1993年联合国对UNITA实施贸易禁运后，来自扎伊尔的规避制裁航班屡见不鲜。

en.t: South Carolina's 2nd congressional district special election, 2001
en.s: The 2001 South Carolina 2nd congressional district special election was held on December 18, 2001 to select a Representative for the 2nd congressional district to serve out the remainder of the term for the 107th Congress. en.s: The Battle of Adré took place in Adré, Chad on December 18, 2005. The battle began when the Chadian rebel groups Rally for Democracy and Liberty (RDL) and Platform for Change, Unity, and Democracy (SCUD), allegedly backed by the government of Sudan, attacked the garrison in this city. However, Chadian loyalists, who had been forewarned by military intelligence of the attack, easily repulsed the attackers. Either seventy, one hundred, or three hundred rebels were killed, depending on reports. Governmental losses are unknown, but they lost at least one Russian-made helicopter in a collision with electric wires during the fighting, while another Mil Mi-17 helicopter was heavily damaged by rebel fire which killed at least one crew member.

zh.s: 2005年12月18日，乍得阿德雷发生战役。乍得反叛组织民主与自由联盟（RDL）和变革、团结与民主平台（SCUD）袭击了当地驻军，据称得到苏丹政府支持。乍得政府军事先从情报部门获知袭击，轻易击退了进攻者。根据不同报道，反叛军死亡人数为70人、100人或300人。政府军损失不明，但战斗中至少有一架俄制直升机撞上电线，另有一架米-17直升机遭反叛军炮火重创，至少一名机组人员死亡。

en.s: General elections were held in Bolivia on 18 December 2005. Evo Morales of the Movement for Socialism (MAS) party was elected President of Bolivia with 54% of the vote, the first time a candidate had received an absolute majority since the flawed 1978 elections. Morales was sworn in on 22 January 2006 for a five-year term. The MAS also won a majority of seats in the Chamber of Deputies and emerged as the largest party in the Senate. Simultaneously voters elected prefects, the highest executive office in each of Bolivia's nine departments. This was the first time the office had been chosen at the ballot box.

As a result, leadership and presidency in Chad drifted back and forth between the Christian southerners and Muslim northerners. When one side was in power, the other side usually started a revolutionary war to counter it.

en.s: Final Battle 2010 was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by Ring of Honor. It took place on December 18, 2010, at the Manhattan Center in New York City. en.s: Presidential elections were held in Seychelles between 3 and 5 December 2015.
